name: Timely
summary: Timely records the apps and sites a person uses and turns them into draft time entries that only that person sees. Plans cost $9 to $22 per user a month on annual billing, Starter stops at 5 users and Premium at 50, and approval states start on Premium.

evidence.capability: time entry or clock in and out

facts.text: Timely states that its Memory tracker never records keystrokes, screenshots or audio.
Timely says employers cannot see the activity its Memory tracker captures.
Approval works through custom time entry states, such as Submitted for approval and Approved, on Premium and Unlimited.
Invoices made in Timely arrive in QuickBooks Online as drafts.
Timely hosts all data in EU-based AWS data centres, holds ISO 27001:2022 certification and states that it is not SOC 2 certified or HIPAA compliant.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Billed annually; $11 on monthly billing. Up to 5 users and 20 projects

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Billed annually; $20 on monthly billing. Up to 50 users. Adds time entry states and QuickBooks Online

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: Billed annually; $28 on monthly billing. No user cap. Adds locked time

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Adds SAML single sign-on

hiddenCosts: Starter stops at 5 users and Premium at 50, so a growing team has to move up a plan.
The Tasks add-on starts at $5 per person.

contract.cancellation: Payments are non-refundable, and a cancelled subscription runs to the end of the current period.
contract.dataExport: Reports as PDF, CSV or XLS on every plan.
